summary: A1 Explore review completed with changes-requested. The scope, no-.mjs boundary, thin CLI, shared-module boundary, and direct tsc approach are aligned with the Delivery. Three blocking omissions leave the proposed toolchain unable to guarantee its ESM runtime and TypeScript checks: the package ESM contract and NodeNext import convention are absent, Node typings are not declared, and test TypeScript is excluded from typecheck.

blockingFindings.title: ESM package contract is incomplete
blockingFindings.evidence: The proposed tsconfig uses NodeNext, but the package plan does not require package.json to set type=module or require emitted-ESM-compatible relative import specifiers such as ./version.js. Under NodeNext, the nearest package.json type controls whether .ts files emit as ESM or CommonJS. The Delivery requires a Node.js ESM runtime under dist/.
blockingFindings.impact: A1 can pass a nominal tsc build while emitting CommonJS or produce source imports that fail NodeNext compilation/runtime, violating the fixed ESM and dist/bin/flowkit.js contract.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: In the Explore and its conclusion, require package.json type=module, a Node 22 engine floor, and the NodeNext rule that relative imports in .ts source use their emitted .js specifier. Carry these requirements into the Proposal acceptance checks.

blockingFindings.title: Node type declarations are missing from the toolchain decision
blockingFindings.evidence: The planned production modules use filesystem, path, and child-process boundaries, while tests use node:test, but the listed devDependencies omit @types/node. TypeScript does not include Node's declarations without an installed visible @types/node package.
blockingFindings.impact: The required strict typecheck cannot type the intended Node APIs or node:test imports from the stated dependency set.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Add @types/node as a direct devDependency, pin it to the supported Node 22 major line, and include the Node typings choice in the TypeScript configuration/package decision.

blockingFindings.title: The stated typecheck omits all handwritten test TypeScript
blockingFindings.evidence: The only tsconfig includes src/**/*.ts and excludes tests; the proposed typecheck command is tsc --noEmit. The test command uses tsx, which transpiles and executes tests but does not substitute for a TypeScript semantic check of the test sources.
blockingFindings.impact: Tests can run despite TypeScript type errors, so A1 would not deliver the required typecheck toolchain for all newly handwritten .ts source and test files.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Specify a test tsconfig extending the production tsconfig, include tests/**/*.ts with noEmit, and make the typecheck script run both production and test projects. Quote the Node test glob so Node, rather than the host shell, resolves it consistently across platforms.
